known.via: English Wikipedia "North Fork of Roanoke AVA"

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Virginia AVA on the eastern slopes of the Allegheny Mountains, west of Roanoke. The valley runs 22 miles along the Roanoke River, with vineyards at 1,200 to 2,200 feet. It is named for the North Fork river.
